The final epigenomic input tables are the modality-specific, expand_bed_5000 DiffBind DESeq2 result files for FlashTag-positive and FlashTag-negative populations. Older exploratory peak-universe and summit-window alternatives are not silently substituted for these named inputs. This notebook documents the downstream quantities used in the figures and checks the saved module-enrichment statistics; it does not recount reads or refit the differential models.

Two effect measures are retained: DiffBind `Fold`, and the mutant-minus-control normalized concentration difference used on the volcano x axis. Their different definitions must remain explicit.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `data/upstream/final_tables/H3K27Me3_FTneg*.csv` | Original nonVZ ME3 differential peak results |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig6_KC/6e_Module_enrichment.csv` | Saved differential chromatin / expression summary |
| saved-results | `data/source_tables/Fig6_KC/6o_RPKM.csv` | Saved differential chromatin / expression summary |

See [input locations](../INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](../SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](../config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

```{r setup, include=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
if (!exists("params", inherits = FALSE)) {
  params <- list(recompute = FALSE)
}
candidate_roots <- c(".", "..")
repo_dir <- candidate_roots[vapply(
  candidate_roots, function(path) file.exists(file.path(path, "R", "common.R")),
  logical(1)
)][1]
stopifnot(!is.na(repo_dir))
repo_dir <- normalizePath(repo_dir, winslash = "/")

  message = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  error = FALSE
)
```

## Differential result fields

Read one final result table. Statistical significance is retained from its original p.value/FDR columns; no P value is recomputed from the displayed concentration difference.

```{r differential-result-fields, eval=TRUE}
result_dir <- file.path(repo_dir, "data", "upstream", "final_tables")
me3_results <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    result_dir, "H3K27Me3_FTneg_Modality_H3K27Me3_PeakSet_me3_expand_bed_5000_Condition_FlashtagNeg__genotype_DBA_DESEQ2.csv"
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)
display_log2fc <- me3_results$Conc_Kdm6b_expr - me3_results$Conc_Kdm6b_ctrl
head(
  data.frame(
    DiffBind_Fold = me3_results$Fold,
    Display_concentration_difference = display_log2fc,

    P_value = me3_results$p.value,
    FDR = me3_results$FDR
  )
)
```

## Module enrichment from saved counting units

The hypergeometric universe is defined by background peaks, not genes or interaction records. For each module, the one-sided upper-tail probability is computed from its selected/background counts, and Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment is applied over the tested modules.

```{r module-enrichment-from-saved-counting-units, eval=TRUE}
enrichment <- read.csv(
  file.path(
    repo_dir, "data", "source_tables", "Fig6_KC", "6e_Module_enrichment.csv"
  )
)
calculated_p <- phyper(
  q = enrichment$Selected_peaks - 1,
  m = enrichment$Background_peaks,
  n = enrichment$Background_total -
    enrichment$Background_peaks,
    k = enrichment$Selected_total,
    lower.tail = FALSE
)
calculated_fdr <- p.adjust(calculated_p, method = "BH")
stopifnot(
  isTRUE(
    all.equal(calculated_p, enrichment$Hypergeometric_P, tolerance = 1e-10)
  )
)
stopifnot(
  isTRUE(all.equal(calculated_fdr, enrichment$BH_FDR, tolerance = 1e-10))
)
head(
  enrichment[, c("Module_figure", "Fold_enrichment", "Hypergeometric_P", "BH_FDR")]
)
```

## RPKM counting convention

Displayed RPKM values are derived from raw counts, gene lengths and the sum of gene counts in each library. These are descriptive expression values; the original RNA differential statistics are retained separately and are not inferred from RPKM.

```{r rpkm-counting-convention, eval=TRUE}
expression <- read.csv(file.path(repo_dir, "data", "source_tables", "Fig6_KC", "6o_RPKM.csv"))
calculated_rpkm <- as.double(expression$Raw_count) *
  1e+09/(as.double(expression$Gene_length_bp) *
  as.double(expression$Library_sum_gene_counts))
stopifnot(
  max(abs(calculated_rpkm - expression$RPKM)) <
    1e-08
)
```
